ENGINE_AUTHORITY.ENGINE_SEMANTICS: donor slotpair mode unchanged: mutate 0, force_unpruned 0, exact U for every pair with g1+g2 > C_ij, safe-bound pruning otherwise; binary reused in place, not rebuilt
ENGINE_AUTHORITY.SMOKE_REUSE: NOT_REUSED: the preflight (18,19) smoke used G4 seed 0 with no samples, no execution identity and no out.json checkpoint, so it lacks the formal record format; RUN1 recomputes it

ORBIT_REDUCTION.MAPPING_SHA256_CONVENTION: sha256 of json.dumps(ROWS, separators=(',', ':')) UTF-8 (ensure_ascii default, keys in build_mapping insertion order), ROWS = 190 rows in lexicographic ORDERED_PAIR order; ORDERED slots index the C2 artifact full_portfolio, ENGINE slots index the sorted (normalized) portfolio
ORBIT_REDUCTION.MAPPING_NOTE: this serialization is specific to this task; it is not required to match the bytes of any earlier differently purposed table
ORBIT_REDUCTION.COVERAGE_ARGUMENT: a number permutation fixing the START maps each slot pair's legal replacements bijectively onto those of the image pair with equal OFFICIAL_ANY_PRIZE count; each of the 190 pairs carries an explicit witness re-checked by validate_mapping

ACCOUNTING.DENOMINATOR_CONVENTION: RAW = C(C(49,6),2) unordered pairs of distinct tickets (the donor engine's raw_total_pairs); ILLEGAL = pairs with at least one of the 18 untouched tickets (would duplicate a ticket); LEGAL = C(C(49,6)-18,2) = EXACTLY_SCORED + SOUNDLY_PRUNED_LEGAL; the donor's n_pruned_hist = ILLEGAL + SOUNDLY_PRUNED_LEGAL. Each candidate is counted in exactly one of ILLEGAL, EXACTLY_SCORED, SOUNDLY_PRUNED_LEGAL.
ACCOUNTING.TOTALS_NOTE: sums over representatives, not multiplied by orbit size; never added to any other denominator

BEST_PORTFOLIO_BASIS: START_RETAINED: no strictly improving replacement; delta 0 is attained by the identity replacement (donor semantics: no move)
TIE_BREAK_SCOPE: per-representative top-SHA records (G3) are minima within that representative's scored tie list only; they are not a minimum-SHA claim over the 190-pair space. The orbit argument covers the best score and the existence of a gain.

BUDGET.BASIS: contract PRIOR_CONSUMED_SECONDS plus the wall time of every execution up to its last state save (saved at least every 60 s while sweeping)
